title: Implement RFC 3977 NNTP command parser
description:
Implement a line-oriented NNTP command parser: read a CR LF-terminated line, tokenize, dispatch to a command handler. Handle commands: CAPABILITIES, MODE READER, QUIT, LIST (ACTIVE, NEWSGROUPS, OVERVIEW.FMT), NEWGROUPS, NEWNEWS, GROUP, NEXT, LAST, ARTICLE, HEAD, BODY, STAT, OVER, XOVER, POST, IHAVE, AUTHINFO, STARTTLS. Unknown commands return 500. Artifact: reader/src/session/parser.rs and dispatcher.rs.

Acceptance:
- Parser handles RFC 3977 line length limit (512 bytes for commands)
- Unknown command returns 500 response
- QUIT closes session cleanly
- Parser is fuzz-tested with a corpus of malformed lines (no panics)
- All 200/300/400/500 response codes match RFC 3977 tables
